caption: The video showcases a macro view of a tightly packed cluster of iridescent soap bubbles glowing with thin-film blues, oranges, yellows, and magentas on a black field. A fixed overlay of corner brackets and the labels "SOAP BUBBLES," "%100," and "MICRO ASMR / STEREOKROMA," with a muted-sound icon, stays locked as the bubbles move beneath it. The whole cluster drifts slowly leftward and slightly downward, carrying its rounded and teardrop cells across the lit area. Within each bubble the colored films swirl and reshape, orange and blue patches flowing into new configurations rather than holding a static pattern. The dark gap-network between neighboring bubbles widens and narrows as the cells jostle and deform, though the overall packing is preserved. At the right the circular edge of the field of view stays fixed as the cells drift past it. This drift and color flow persist steadily, with no settling or final arrangement visible.
